programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Food Network's Giada De Laurentiis brings in pal Meredith Vieira to try to beat Bobby Flay in 25 ingredients or fewer chefs Marcos Campos and Nicholas Poulmetis try not to slip up on the star ingredient for a shot at taking down the king.

programme.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores the cuisine of Sitka, Alaska, where the preparation of iconic Alaskan staples like king salmon, venison and rockfish has evolved with finesse.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern shares the best of weird and wild Portland, Ore., a city whose personality is apparent in its food culture local favorites include boozy doughnuts, Thai fish sauce chicken wings and even crawfish boils.

programme.title: Chopped: Cooking With Bass
programme.desc: The appetizer baskets hold chicken hearts as one of the mandatory ingredients the entrée round baskets feature sea bass and an expensive spice the chefs must combine brittle and zucchini for the final round.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Bobby Flay's friends Damaris Phillips and Michael Symon get together for the very first time to try to take their pal down he'll have to tango with fellow New Yorkers Andrew Lukovsky and Airis Johnson, who aren't going down without a fight.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Culinary legend Wolfgang Puck makes his first-ever appearance at the Beat Bobby Flay arena alongside "Chopped" guru Ted Allen chefs Emily Hansen and Judy Anderson must impress the dynamic duo to get the chance to fillet the Flay.
